summary: Implemented the progress reading feature in rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ReaderContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file), added 13 tests to tests/test_progress.py, documented it in docs/source/progress.rst, and added a CHANGELOG.md entry linking PR 1759. The diff is additive and nothing is committed. Nothing was run: tests, black, and mypy were not executed, per the instructions. Known risks: the module-level open passes a str mode to the Literal-overloaded Progress.open, which mypy will likely flag, and the 3.6 metaclass mix for the reader class is unverified.
